name: si.tehnokot/shop
title: Tehnokot.si
description: Used business IT shop in Slovenia: search, stock, cart links, orders paid by the buyer on PayPal.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Tehnokot.si, a Slovenian shop for used business IT equipment (laptops, servers, UPS, network gear, server parts). Most items are single pieces. Prices in EUR including VAT; shipping within Slovenia only. Query words match name, brand, model, SKU and specs (Slovenian or English model names work best, e.g. "ThinkPad", "R740", "DDR4 ECC").

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one product: description, specifications, condition, warranty, stock and price. Pass the id (from search) or the slug from its URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Product categories with the number of items in stock. Use the slug with search_products.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Current availability of up to 50 products by id: in stock (na-zalogi, with count), reserved by someone paying right now (rezervirano, may return within 30 minutes) or sold (prodano).

tools.name: build_cart_link
tools.description: Checks the items against current stock and returns a link that opens the shop's cart with them. Give the link to the person: they review the cart and pay with PayPal themselves. Nothing is reserved until they place the order, and single pieces can sell in the meantime.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Places a real order for a person and returns a PayPal link. The items are reserved for 30 minutes; the person must open payment_url and approve the payment on PayPal (card or PayPal account), otherwise the order lapses and nothing is charged. Prices come from the shop, not from you. Only use it when the person asked to buy and gave you their details. By setting accept_terms you confirm that the person accepts the terms of sale (https://tehnokot.si/pogoji-poslovanja) and knows how their data is used (https://tehnokot.si/zasebnost). Delivery only within Slovenia. Used goods from resale, no warranty unless stated; 14 days to withdraw.

buyer.description: Required unless the person is signed in (then their account e-mail is used and missing fields come from my_account's last delivery address; anything given here overrides it).

email.description: Where the order confirmation goes (ignored when signed in: the account's e-mail is used).

street.description: Street and house number (required for delivery).

company.description: For an invoice to a company.

delivery.description: posta = Pošta Slovenije; prevzem = pick-up (only if the shop offers it).

accept_terms.description: true only if the person accepts the terms of sale and the privacy notice.

accept_used_goods.description: true only if the person separately and explicitly confirms the shortened liability period: "Strinjam se, da za kupljeno rabljeno blago velja skrajšan 1-letni rok odgovornosti za skladnost blaga od dobave." Required by law; ask it as its own question.

accept_defects.description: Ids of the products whose known_defects (get_product) the person explicitly accepted, one separate question per product, with that product's defects_confirmation sentence. Required for every ordered product that has known_defects.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Status of an order: waiting for payment, paid, shipped (carrier, tracking link), delivered or cancelled. Needs order_id and order_key from place_order; a signed-in person's own orders need no key (order_id or the order number like Z2026-00012).

order_id.description: order_id from place_order or my_orders, or the order number.

order_key.description: order_key from place_order (not needed for the signed-in person's own orders).

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: The signed-in person's account at the shop: name, e-mail and the delivery details of their last order (to prefill place_order), and how many orders they have. Needs sign-in: the first call asks the person to connect their Tehnokot.si account.

tools.name: my_orders
tools.description: The signed-in person's orders, newest first: number, status, items, total, carrier and tracking link, delivery, invoice number, and whether withdrawal (14 days) is still possible. Needs sign-in: the first call asks the person to connect their Tehnokot.si account.
